title: TellOnce: Correcting Coding Agents Once, Improving Their Future Actions
abstract: arXiv:2606.13174v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Interactive LLM agents increasingly work with users across tasks, yet remembering a previous correction does not ensure that the agent changes its behavior in the future. In a diagnostic constructed from anonymized real-world agent interactions, agents using Mem0 still violate 57.5% of applicable preference checks. We introduce TellOnce, a drop-in personalization layer that turns conversational corrections into persistent, scoped, and revisable behavioral rules without updating the underlying agent model. TellOnce identifies which requirements should persist, determines when they apply, reconciles subsequent feedback with existing rules, and prepares reusable checks when reliable verification is possible. We evaluate whether learned corrections improve future behavior by freezing the learned state and testing on subsequent tasks without additional user corrections. translated_title: TellOnce：一次纠正编程智能体，改善其未来行为
translated_abstract: 交互式LLM智能体越来越多地跨任务与用户协作，然而记住先前的纠正并不能确保智能体在未来改变其行为。在一个基于匿名化真实智能体交互构建的诊断测试中，使用Mem0的智能体仍然违反了57.5%的适用偏好检查。我们提出了TellOnce，一个即插即用的个性化层，它能够将对话式纠正转化为持久、有作用范围且可修订的行为规则，而无需更新底层的智能体模型。TellOnce识别哪些要求应当持久化、确定它们何时适用、将后续反馈与现有规则进行调和，并在可靠验证可行时准备可复用的检查项。我们通过冻结学习到的状态并在后续任务上测试（无需额外的用户纠正），来评估所学到的纠正能否改善智能体的未来行为。在ClawArena和MemoryArena上对三个模型的评估中，TellOnce实现了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: TellOnce是一个无需更新底层模型的即插即用个性化层，能将用户对智能体的对话式纠正转化为持久、有作用范围且可修订的行为规则，使智能体在未来的任务中持续改善行为、遵守用户偏好。
en_tdlr: TellOnce is a drop-in personalization layer that turns conversational corrections into persistent, scoped, and revisable behavioral rules, enabling LLM agents to improve their future actions across tasks without updating the underlying model.
